detail.longDescription: I have a Node.js/React application running in Docker on an AWS EC2 instance, with Nginx in front of it. Before patching, my team manually stops the application container using docker stop <container-id>. After we stop container , we see bad gateway in website. After the EC2 patching/reboot is completed, the container is manually started again using docker start <container-id>. Normally, the application works correctly. However, after some patching/reboots, I have observed this sequence: After the EC2 reboot, when we restart docker container the website initially shows the default Nginx welcome page. I'm not sure , how Application correct page return but I have guess, Devops team may be manually stopping/restarting the container during this period. I would like to understand what could cause the default Nginx page to appear immediately after the EC2 reboot
